fixes.explanation: You caught it, baker! The song says, "God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress." The fortress isn't a wall or an army. It's God Himself.
Right on, baker. The song says, "As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts…" What they heard matches what they saw.
That's right, baker. The song says, "Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth…" That's about as far as far gets.
